column3: Upon any of the Sheraton Denver Downtown Hotel Whole Loan, the 255 Greenwich Whole Loan and the Ellenton Premium Outlets Whole Loan becoming a specially serviced loan under the BANK 2025-BNK51 PSA, the related Non-Serviced Special Servicer thereunder will earn a special servicing fee payable monthly with respect to such Whole Loan accruing at a rate equal to the greater of 0.25% per annum and the rate that would result in a special servicing fee of $5,000 for the related month.
